scope: Whole readable shell source and Swedish local-use steps reviewed against current Linux portability evidence. Source-only; no Mac or Docker invocation.

checks.dockerSelectionPrecedence: DOCKER_CONTEXT, then DOCKER_HOST, else docker context show; explicit context inspection first; no override to another context

findings.problem: Pipeline wc could emit zero after docker ps failure.
findings.resolution: Count emitted only after successful captured ps; zero only on successful empty output; failures report unavailable. system df failures also report unavailable.
findings.wholeSourceInverseVerified: Exactly the two reporting branches invert to original reviewed script SHA.

officialDocumentationProvenance: Root verified current official Modes and Docker Settings documentation; reviewer did not claim a separate web fetch.
limitations: Architecture/RAM/disk/Docker findings are unavailable until the script actually runs on the chosen Mac.
Docker Unix socket may front another host; identity and VM placement still require verification.
